name: mcp-web-validator
title: Web Validator (lightweight)
description: Two local HTML inspection tools: SEO metadata and JSON-LD syntax.

tools.name: seo.metadata
tools.title: Audit SEO metadata
tools.description: Inspects supplied HTML locally for title, meta description, h1 headings, and image alt attributes.

tools.name: schema.markup
tools.title: Validate JSON-LD syntax
tools.description: Parses JSON-LD script blocks in supplied HTML and reports empty blocks or JSON syntax errors.
